subject: run code in background and send notification?

messages.author: d3e2e3c09c385ed8
messages.subject: run code in background and send notification?
parts:
Hi everyone,

Suppose I have a function f(x,y,z) that takes a while to run, for example 48 hours. Is it possible to create a shiny app that allows me to choose x y z, and then runs this function on the background and sends me a notification with rpushbullet? 

Ideally, i would like to be able to close my browser after choosing x y z and pressing the run button. If the answer is yes, could you point me in the right direction? If the answer is not, do you think opencpu could be used to do this?

Thanks!

Ignacio

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] run code in background and send notification?
parts:
Applications running on shinyapps.io will terminate 15 minutes after the last user of the application closes their browser. Your use-case doesn't sound like something that would work well on shinyapps.io, as the platform is designed for interactive applications versus long running jobs.

You might look into a platform like https://www.dominodatalab.com/
